newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Bancorp to acquire Sun Capital.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Bancorp to acquire Sun Capital.

text.p: U.S. Bancorp said Wednesday it has agreed to acquire Sun Capital Bancorp and unit, Sun Capital Bank, a three-branch banking operation with about $70 million in assets based in St. George, Utah.
The deal is valued at about $15.5 million. U.S. Bancorp will buyback about 400,000 shares reissue them to acquire Sun Capital. The deal is expected to close by year-end 1996.

"Sun Capital is a great fit for us because it gives us presence in a rapidly growing area and strengthens our ties in both Utah and Nevada" Gerry Cameron, U.S. Bancorp chief executive said in a statement.
